Our Global Data Plan covers over 150 Countries and 20 Airlines.
✈️ Travel the world with hassle-free data!
Say goodbye to roaming fees and constant phone toggling. Our Global Data Plans automatically connect to local networks as you travel.
● No interruption, no hassle
● Works across countries seamlessly
● Fast, reliable internet wherever you go
A FlexiRoam eSIM Data Plan comes with:
● Complimentary eSIM included with data plan.
● Flexible start date after activation.
● Share your data from Fixed Data Plans with family and friends with Flexi Share.
● No more expensive roaming bills and hidden charges.
